    for s in songs:
        sid = s.get('song_id')
        if sid is None:
            continue
        if sid in seen_song_ids:
            continue
        seen_song_ids.add(sid)
        all_recs.append(s)
    page_index += 1

print('total_unique_recommended_songs', len(all_recs))

from datetime import datetime

# Determine target years from current datetime
now = datetime.now()
this_year = now.year
last_year = this_year - 1
target_years = {this_year, last_year}
print('now', now.isoformat())
print('target_years', sorted(target_years))

# Login to Spotify
login = apis.spotify.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password='K8@@L3Q')
access_token = login['access_token']

# Fetch all personalized recommendations (paginate)
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
seen_song_ids = set()
recommended_song_ids = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for item in page:
        sid = item.get('song_id')
        if sid is None:
            continue
        if sid in seen_song_ids:
            continue
        seen_song_ids.add(sid)
        recommended_song_ids.append(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('unique_recommended_song_ids', len(recommended_song_ids))
print('recommended_song_ids_sample', recommended_song_ids[:15])

# Filter: genre == 'R&B' (case-insensitive) and release_date year in target_years
filtered = []
for sid in recommended_song_ids:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(sid)
    genre = song.get('genre')
    release_date = song.get('release_date')
    year = None
    if isinstance(release_date, str) and len(release_date) >= 4:
        try:
            year = int(release_date[:4])
        except:
            year = None
    is_rnb = isinstance(genre, str) and genre.strip().lower() == 'r&b'
    if is_rnb and (year in target_years):
        filtered.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': song.get('title'),
            'album_title': song.get('album_title'),
            'artist_names': [a.get('name') for a in song.get('artists', []) if a.get('name')],
            'release_date': release_date,
            'genre': genre,
            'release_year': year
        })

print('filtered_rnb_release_this_or_last_year_count', len(filtered))
# Print full filtered list as verification artifact (IDs + title + year)
for x in filtered:
    print(x['song_id'], x['title'], 'year=', x['release_year'])
